title: Jesus... Two Doors Are Open And I Can't Hear You. 🚪
topic: she must choose between two job offers in two cities and every voice around her is louder than the peace she is praying for

bible.text: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... two doors are open and I can't hear You. 🚪

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Two offers, two cities. Everyone has advice. I only want Yours.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're waiting for a voice when I mostly give a pace. Peace is My green light.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if I pick wrong and lose what both doors are offering?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: A step taken with Me can be corrected. A step avoided can't. Walk toward peace.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Acknowledge Me in this decision today. I'm not silent; I'm directing.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend stuck at a crossroads this week. 🚪
